summary: Preserved PR 2728's six structurally valid unified-memory exact-KL cases and independently reproduced PR 2781's remaining counterexamples. On the assigned ROCm gfx950 host, Inkling reaches its NVIDIA CUTE/FA4 path and fails because the pinned environment has no cutlass module. No end-to-end Inkling request, KL value, or real FULL/SWA/MAMBA fault-injection red was possible, so no speculative state-restoration source correction was made.

tests.what_was_measured: 24 cases collected, including six candidate unified-memory cases spanning baseline, prefill cache hit, and decode cache hit for Python and Rust tree cores. This is collection evidence only.

The actual candidate class resolved its unified-memory, Triton, deterministic-inference, disabled-prefill-graph, and Inkling revision settings, but did not complete startup or an HTTP request on ROCm. No KL value was measured. The launcher terminated its parent test process before pytest emitted a normal summary; the isolated import command records the source exception.
Inkling import traversed sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_attn.cute.interface and raised ModuleNotFoundError: No module named cutlass.

3 tests and 4 subtests passed bit-for-bit on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 against the independent stock-pool reference. This does not cover Inkling, SWA, MAMBA, radix cache hits, or the candidate classes.

gpu_execution_evidence: Unified MLA parity kernels executed on one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 under ROCm 7.2. The Inkling candidate did not reach GPU inference.
remaining_limitations: No supported NVIDIA CUTLASS/FA4 run demonstrates exact zero KL for baseline, prefill-cache-hit, or decode-cache-hit cases.
Neither Python nor Rust candidate class completed an end-to-end Inkling request.
No real unified-memory FULL, SWA, or MAMBA state-restoration defect could be run revert-then-red or via fault injection.
The passing MLA parity test is component-only and does not qualify Inkling's combined architecture or the new classes.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify Inkling semantics or its combined FULL+SWA+MAMBA state.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json provides no native rebuild target.
